description: This module manages load-balancers on Scaleway.

parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if profile is not specified.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of api_token. It is also possible to set SCW_PROFILE to use a SCW CLI config profile.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.description: List of parameters passed to the query string. Default: {}

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the instance. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: List of tags to apply to the load-balancer. Default: []

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for the load-balancer to reach its desired state before returning. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: wait_sleep_time
parameters.description: Time to wait before every attempt to check the state of the load-balancer. Default: 3

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: Time to wait for the load-balancer to reach the expected state. Default: 300

examples:
- name: Create a load-balancer
  community.general.scaleway_lb:
    name: foobar
    state: present
    organization_id: 951df375-e094-4d26-97c1-ba548eeb9c42
    region: fr-par
    tags:
      - hello

- name: Delete a load-balancer
  community.general.scaleway_lb:
    name: foobar
    state: absent
    organization_id: 951df375-e094-4d26-97c1-ba548eeb9c42
    region: fr-par
